content.value: All tomes respect the equipment rune cap. Wood, stone, leather, shields and bows cap at T10; iron, chainmail, gold and crossbows at T9; diamond at T8; netherite at T7.

Transmutation: Normal to Magic with one rune.
Augmentation: adds a rune to Magic equipment.
Regal: Magic to Rare, adding one rune.
Exalted: adds a rune to Rare equipment. Existing rune families are excluded before rolling, and prefix/suffix capacity still applies.

Alchemy works on Normal, Magic and Rare gear. It reforges editable runes into up to two prefixes and two suffixes, preserving protected properties.
Chaos replaces the rune you select with a weighted random rune on the same affix side. It requires Rare gear.
Divine rerolls numeric values of the chosen rune inside its existing tier, bounded by the equipment cap. Other runes are unchanged.
Annulment removes the chosen editable rune, leaving space for another craft.

Replacing, removing, rerolling values or reforging existing runes spends one tome and saves one proposal. Keep current or Use new resolves that paid attempt; neither gives a refund. Closing the screen or restarting preserves the same proposal. New additions to empty slots are applied immediately.

Stronger random tome variants keep the same eligible family pool. Greater removes T10 outcomes where possible; Perfect removes T9 and T10 where possible. The equipment cap always wins. A wooden sword still receives T10, even from a Perfect tome.
